refinement_instructions: Rewrite the trace so it no longer begins with ungrounded equations. First cite the retrieved puzzle frame(s) and OCR results for the displayed measurements in the first two cases. Then use the dense-captioned opening segment to describe the arrangement in each case (for example, how many glasses are shown in each stack or comparison) and map those visual counts to variables before writing equations. Preserve the algebra only after the premises are grounded from the image. If OCR/frame evidence shows different numbers or a different object-to-variable mapping than the original trace assumed, replace the equations accordingly and update the final answer. When using Step 1/2 outputs, inspect the frame-level OCR evidence across all candidate frames rather than assuming the top-ranked frame is correct.
